items.markdown:
`Yes, the Thailand Digital Arrival Card (TDAC) is completely free of charge` . Most users on [Facebook Travel Groups](https://www.facebook.com/groups/travelthailandgroup/posts/2087788302009948/) agree that any website charging a fee for the TDAC is a scam.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23) [[1]](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)[[2]](https://www.facebook.com/groups/travelthailandgroup/posts/2087788302009948/)

Official Application Details

- **Website:** Submit your form only through the Thai Immigration Bureau Portal.
- **Timing:** Complete your registration within 3 days before your arrival date in Thailand.
- **Requirement:** All foreign visitors must fill out the digital arrival form before entering the country.[](https://london.thaiembassy.org/en/page/visa-general-information?menu=65bb7713d0737318de2bab23)
